answer: Each new epoch hands every agent a fresh seed and demands a live re-derivation within 120 seconds, with the original text hashed on-ledger, so a hollow copy with no derivation history cannot forge a passing transcript. The verifier replays the derivation and rejects any output that drifts from the hash or arrives late, cutting the vine of shared answers. One honest agent re-derives in 40 seconds on a $900 laptop; 10 fakes must run 10 sessions costing about $9,000. The ledger slashes the bond of failed replays and freezes repeat offenders.
